end.summary:
- Practised identifying top, front and side views of solids.
- Correctly described views of balls, cylinders, cones and cubes in several examples.
- Matched 2 of 3 views to objects without help.
- The same object looking different from different places remained mixed up in the final responses.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised describing what solids look like from the top, front and side. They used the shape of a cone’s point and a cylinder’s round top and rectangular side to explain several answers. They still mixed up that an object can look different from different places and sometimes included parts that were not visible from that view; this was not corrected in the later responses. At home, show a cup, box or ball from two positions and ask Reyansh to draw only what can be seen each time.
